subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Dust has _________ in the crevices of the house.
solution: The correct answer is** Option (2) i.e. "gathered".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Gathered: (इकट्ठा हुआ) **- To come together, or bring things together, to form a group or accumulate. • **Example**: Guests gathered in the hall to celebrate. • In this context, it suggests that dust has accumulated in the cracks of the house over time. **Therefore, the correct complete sentence is *"Dust has gathered__ in the crevices of the house."*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Flown:(उड़ गया)** - Past participle of fly, meaning to move through the air. • **Assembled:(इकट्ठा किया)** - To come together or bring components together in a single group or structure. • **Lived:(रहते थे) **- To inhabit or reside somewhere. 58:Tb7e,
